description: Which strategies can I backtest here? Lists all backtest strategies (key, label, plan, supported asset classes, primary indicators). Filterable by asset class and plan. Use this before calling arena_run_backtest to discover valid strategy names. Entries deprecated for an asset class stay listed (historical results depend on them) and carry deprecated_for + deprecation {since, reason} — do NOT call arena_run_backtest or validate_strategy for those combinations, they return 400. [Free tier]

asset_class.description: Filter to strategies supporting this asset class (crypto or tokenized_rwa).

plan.description: Filter to strategies of this plan tier.
